name: Sara personality report — friend view
description: Log in as markly.1, visit sara.1's profile, click the Personality card to open the Big Five report modal, scroll through the modal, and capture the full report.
checks: A personality-report modal/dialog is visible in the report screenshots (overlay on top of the profile).
The modal has a heading like 'Your Big Five Personality Test' and shows Sara's trait type (e.g. Neuroticism) and sub-sections such as Overview, Strengths, Growth areas.
Between the mid and bottom screenshots, the modal's visible content should change (scrolled further down inside the modal).
Please read the modal and give a few-sentence summary of what it says about Sara — try to include any section that is only visible after scrolling.
